"Earlybird" and "Starlighter" Discounts - average 20%.
• Reduced fares in effect from 12:01 AM to 6:30 AM, seven days
a week.
• and from 8 PM to 12 Midnight except Fridays and Sundays.
Mahalo Group-10 Fares
Discounts
average 20%.
Reduced fares on flights scheduled to
depart from 12:01 PM to 7:59 AM. Applies to a group of 10 or more
passengers 12 years of age or older traveling together. Stopovers
permitted at a charge of $13 (inc. tax) for each stopover.
Hawaiian Air Travel Club Fares save up to 50%.
Savings of approximately 20% off regular full fare. Reduced fares
on flights scheduled to depart from 12:01 PM to 7:59 AM except
"Earlybird"
and
"Starlighter"
discount flights. Stopovers permitted
at a charge of $13 (inc. tax) for each stopover on 20% discount
flights only.
Also a Bonus Discount of approximately 50% off the
regular full fare is in effect for all regularly scheduled flights de-
parting Honolulu from 6:30 PM to 6:30 AM. Available to passengers
12 years of age or over by the one time purchase of a $5 member-
ship card which must be presented at time of ticket purchase.
Senior Citizen Standby Fare:
Space available reduced fares available to any person 65 years of
age and over who buys a $5.00 Senior Citizen membership card.
or possesses a Hawaiian Air Club membership card and shows
proof of age. Card must be presented at time of ticket purchase.
A new card must be purchased to replace lost card. May standby
on any flight. Stopover not permitted.
